subtitle: Look, name, copy
question: How do you know what your body just did?
promise: In this unit you will watch a shape, name the parts of it, and copy it. Then a partner will watch you.
learn: Name four parts of your body

title: Names for my body
text: Point to your head. Point to your arms. Point to your legs. Point to your feet. A watcher needs these four words.
say: Name the part as you touch it. The word lands better with a hand on it.

title: Draw and name
text: Draw your body in the box. Put a dot on your head, your arms, your legs and your feet.
ask: Draw your body. Say each part out loud.

text: Willow watches first. Then she says exactly what she saw.

steps.text: Watch the shape. Say what you see.
Copy the shape. Hold it still.
Let a partner copy you. Watch them do it.

title: Show me good
text: Do each one. Then circle how ready it felt.
Make one shape with your body. Hold it while a partner counts to five. Then swap and copy their shape.

words.meaning: look with your whole eyes, and wait
make the same shape as someone
what your body makes, standing or moving
